purpose: Execute the frozen target-anchor DGP with approved version-2 ARIMA reporting while validating unchanged quantities across archived NumPy 2.4.0 and pinned NumPy 2.4.4 environments.

cross_version_numeric_equivalence.rule: For unchanged numeric quantities, require absolute difference no greater than 1e-7 plus 1e-10 times the absolute archived reference value.
cross_version_numeric_equivalence.scope: Only archived-reference comparisons across NumPy 2.4.0 and 2.4.4. It does not relax structural constraints, target-anchor invariance checks, or within-environment independent reproduction.

approved_reporting_change.reason: The version-2 ARIMA standard error and target-containment decision are the approved quantities being recomputed.
